mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) growth signals rising corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1's 12-month rolling trend is upward, or the 12-month rolling IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting market anticipation of labor market tightening.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.0%, or the signal occurs during a high inflation period with conflicting market sentiment.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward trends in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) create a synergistic effect, amplifying positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and HOUST does not produce significantly higher returns than either proxy alone (IC > 0.05) over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% signals accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns do not rise significantly (IC < 0.03) when FEDFUNDS declines below 4.0% during a tightening cycle, or the 60d IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 104.0 triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, indicating robust manufacturing activity.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 104.0, or the signal occurs during a contractionary phase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly labor participation (PAYEMS) above 159,500 signals strong employment momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns are not significantly positive (IC < 0.05) when PAYEMS trends upward, or the signal occurs during high volatility periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in labor participation (PAYEMS) create a reinforcing labor market signal, amplifying positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS does not produce significantly higher returns than either proxy alone (IC > 0.05) over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession recovery phase, a sustained rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) above 23528 (current value) signals stronger growth expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are not significantly positive (IC < 0.03) when GDPC1 exceeds 23528 during a recovery phase, or the 12-month rolling IC remains below 0.03.
